name: Reedmother Ysolt
place: coils in the channels between Brackwater and Eelwick; boatmen leave her eels
_doc: Stream E (M2). A serpent as long as a barge. She snaps the farthest player toward her with a lash (pull), constricts in a ring around herself (get right up close or well away), and at half health starts spitting venom that leaves green pools.

party.solo: Solo-able by ranged classes who stay outside the coil.
party.full: Easy; keep the pools out of the melee spot.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The water ripples in a long, long line toward you.
Ysolt rises out of the reeds, swaying.
say.death: Reedmother Ysolt sinks, slowly, and the reeds close over her.
say.reset: Ysolt slides back under the water.

lash.name: Tail Lash
lash.say: {boss} draws back her tail — whoever is behind {target} gets reeled in!

coil.name: Constrict
coil.say: Ysolt coils around the spot — hug her or get well clear!

phases.name: Spitting
phases.say: Ysolt hisses and venom drips from her jaws!
